Know Distributed work already?

One question for each of the 4 puzzles in this module. A right answer marks that puzzle as passed, so you can jump ahead. A wrong one tells you which puzzle to start with. Nothing is sent anywhere: it's saved in this browser.

Puzzle 7: How do you send an event after a crash?

The sender transaction rolls back after inserting both rows. What can the relay find?

Not quite. Both writes were in the same transaction. Learn it in puzzle 7 →

Right. The rollback removes both rows.

Puzzle 8: Why can retries prolong an outage?

New traffic is 80/s, retries are 20/s and capacity is 100/s. What happens to 300 queued requests?

Not quite. Retries consume the spare capacity. Learn it in puzzle 8 →

Right. Total arrivals equal completion capacity.

Puzzle 9: When does splitting the data help?

What can a month-based split help with?

Not quite. One hot inventory row can still serialize writes. Learn it in puzzle 9 →

Right. One hot inventory row can still serialize writes.

Puzzle 10: Who can confirm a write when regions cannot talk?

How many form a majority of five?

Not quite. Two groups of two need not intersect. Learn it in puzzle 10 →

Right. Two groups of two need not intersect.
